visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair wearing a white T-shirt stands in a brightly lit, modern department store skincare counter. He holds a microphone and gestures excitedly towards the brand signage reading 'Domohorn Wrinkle'. (2) The camera pans to show the store's interior, featuring minimalist white counters and wooden shelving displays filled with neatly arranged skincare products. (3) The man stands behind a white counter, holding a silver tube and pointing at it while looking directly at the camera. (4) A woman in a white store uniform joins him behind the counter, waving and smiling warmly. (5) In a humorous moment, the camera pulls back to show the woman standing on a black riser to match the man's height while they both laugh. (6) A close-up shot shows a hand applying a white cream from a silver tube onto a tattooed wrist and rubbing it in. (7) The man applies the cream to his face, specifically around his eyes and mouth, while looking into a mirror or the camera. (8) The scene shifts to the man holding a light purple bottle; he shakes it and dispenses a thick, cloud-like white foam onto his hand. (9) He applies the thick foam to one side of his face, creating a dense white layer. (10) Close-up of a beige tube being used; the man applies a small amount to his hand and then his face. (11) The man uses a large white puff to apply powder from a round container to his cheek. (12) He holds up a promotional sample kit containing eight small tubes and bottles in a clear package.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the new physical store location over an upbeat acoustic guitar and drum rhythm. (2) Vocal tone is enthusiastic with frequent rising intonation as he starts reviewing the first product. (3) A female voice enters with a polite, service-oriented greeting, accompanied by a bright 'Ding' sound effect. (4) Interaction includes audible laughter and playful vocal dynamics as they reveal the 'height' secret. (5) Detailed product explanation follows with clear, enunciated speech and rhythmic BGM support. (6) A bubble-like pop sound effect occurs during the foam demonstration. (7) Final segment features a fast-paced call to action with high vocal arousal and concluding music swells.
